package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// CourseTagRepoPG implements CourseTagRepository.
type CourseTagRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Replace updates course tag links to exact set.
func (r CourseTagRepoPG) Replace(ctx context.Context, courseID string, tagIDs []int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM course_tag WHERE course_id=$1`, courseID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, tagID := range tagIDs {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_tag (course_id, tag_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, courseID, tagID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.CourseTagRepository = (*CourseTagRepoPG)(nil)
